title: What Happens When You Stop a GLP-1 Medicine?
description: What semaglutide and tirzepatide withdrawal studies show about regain, and how to plan a treatment transition.
author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation

hero.alt: A woman in a rust-colored jacket walking beside a river in autumn.

body.alt: SURMOUNT-4: over weeks 36 to 88, mean weight change was minus 5.5% continuing tirzepatide and plus 14.0% switching to placebo, relative to week-36 weight. Whiskers show 95% confidence intervals.
body.before_heading: Regain is not a measure of character
